create · import
Anki only: the import wizard brings it in.

missing · sync
File gone: Sync decides, nothing to push.

span.p:
CHECK
quiet · sync
Both sides match: nothing to write.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / FORCE_PUSH (force)
skip · sync
force: FORCE_PUSH (Obsidian wins)
Newer in Anki: skipped, use Sync. Forced: Obsidian wins: overwrites Anki.

span.p:
PUSH
overwrite · export
Newer in Obsidian: pushes to Anki.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / FORCE_PUSH (force)
conflict · sync
force: FORCE_PUSH (Obsidian wins)
Edited in both: skipped, use Sync. Forced: Obsidian wins: overwrites Anki.

span.p:
ENROLL
quiet · wizard
Has an id but no record: enrols it, writes nothing.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EXPORT
create · export
Vault only: creates the Anki note, writes the id back.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENROLL
quiet · wizard
Has an id but no record: enrols it, writes nothing.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / EXPORT (force)
missing · sync
force: EXPORT (Obsidian wins)
Gone from Anki: Sync applies the deletion. Forced: Obsidian wins: re-creates it in Anki.
